problem_statement: Operators cannot tell why a change was accepted without reading the whole event journal by hand.
desired_outcomes: An operator can answer 'why was this accepted' in under a minute.
The answer cites the validation and review evidence it rests on.

actors.description: The single developer running DevCadience on their own machine.
The frontier principal engineer planning work through compact state.
needs: Know which tasks await a decision

primary_workflows.description: Open a completed task and read the decision with its supporting evidence.

in_scope: Reading acceptance decisions and their evidence

success_criteria: Every accepted change links to its validation and review results.
failure_criteria: An acceptance exists that cannot be explained from durable records.

constraints.statement: The answer must be available with no network access.
Operational UI must not precede a reliable control plane.

assumptions.statement: One operator uses one control plane at a time.

unknowns: Whether operators want the explanation as text or as a rendered timeline.
